response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating) SELECT AVG(avg_duration) AS avg_of_avg_duration, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratio FROM per_rating

assumptions.assumption: 'Pricier-to-replace' with a 20.99 cutoff means replacement_cost strictly greater than 20.99 (not >=).
The final row is an unweighted average of the per-rating averages (each rating counts equally), not an average over all qualifying films.
The per-rating results are an intermediate step (a CTE), and only the final single row is returned.
